description: Immutable snapshot of the unsaved-draft state in TmChat (composer, thread reply, message edit). Consumers build a dirty-guard from it (confirmation before a reload or navigation discards an in-progress message). Carries state flags only — never the draft text itself; the text is delivered in OnSendMessage/OnSend/OnEditMessage on commit. HasUnsavedContent aggregates the slots; for an open message edit it means the text differs from the message as it was when the edit started.
